name: HMIS
description: The Tassia Hill Hospital Multi-Tenant Hospital Management Information System (HMIS) with public health and disease surveillance reporting (eIDSR, MOH 505, WHO IHR 2005, KHIS/DHIS2), offline resilience, installable PWA support, dynamic departmental workflows, paperless billing, smart pharmacy POS, and deep integrations with SHA/Taifa Care, KRA eTIMS, and Safaricom M-PESA.
